intuition: Each source node needs exactly one distinct copy, and its next and random edges must point to corresponding copies.

brute_force.approach: For each source node, search the list again to locate the copies of its next and random targets.

optimal.approach: Use a source-to-copy dictionary, creating copies once and then wiring both pointers through the map.

edge_cases: A random pointer may target the same node.
A random pointer may be null.
